De duplici copia verborum ac rerum commentarii duo (Two Commentaries on the Double Resource of Words and Things) is a rhetoric textbook written in the Renaissance by Erasmus of Rotterdam. The first part of the book is about verborum (words) and includes 147 variations on "Your letter pleased me very much" and 203 variations on "Always, as long as I live."
